## Description

Train an ensemble of decision trees to classify next-period returns or rank assets using engineered features.

## Where it may fit

Nonlinear relationships with adequate, stable historical data and realistic validation.

## Vehicles

Quant equity, ETF selection, FX/crypto research; generally a signal layer rather than standalone portfolio.

## Required data

Point-in-time prices/returns, indicators, volume, macro/fundamental features, labels, training splits and costs.

## Caveats

Leakage, nonstationarity, class imbalance and repeated model selection often invalidate naive backtests.
